notes.title: Update to version 0.1.2
notes.content:
Fixed the bug of inaccurate mouse coordinates, the mouse should be able to click correctly when the screen is zoomed in and out

Added the Three Fairies of Light, placed on the second floor of the Fairy Giant Tree in the Enchanted Forest, which also allows you to bring them out during quick battles
[b]Sunny Milk: [/b]
    Sunny is an explosive fighter that can deal a lot of damage in a short period of time, and she has the following skills:
[olist]
[*]         Sonny's Windmill: Sonny jumps into the air and spins his weapon while approaching the enemy, the spinning weapon will continue to deal damage. This move can be interrupted by a powerful attack or a wall, and once interrupted, Sonny will go straight for a while!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/e7eb7f00fcf2dd088fd5c82c4b182a6c73edcd9b.gif[/img]
[*]         Sunny Counterattack: this is a defensive skill, when Sunny detects that he is going to be attacked, he will probability quickly sprint in the direction of the attack while spinning his weapon to attack, this skill has no foreshock and can be interrupted by an attack or a wall as well
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/d57384bf93f662873b0312341ad327650af79764.gif[/img]
[*]         Direct Sun Shot: when far away from Sunny, Sunny will probability shoot a fan-shaped laser at the target, which is Sunny's long-range attack means
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/9b77be82c1ea22ff205f168864e1005f73e3d080.gif[/img]
[/olist]
[b]Luna Child:[/b]
    Luna is also a warrior, but her DPS isn't as high as Sunny's, and she has some high mobility and support skills:
[olist]
[*]         Spinning Jump: Luna jumps up holding her weapon and spins around to attack, this skill can be interrupted by an attack or a wall, after the skill is interrupted, Luna will be hard for a while
[*]         Luna Sends Wink: Luna fires a huge chestnut at the enemy, which penetrates the enemy, this is Luna's long range attack
[*]         Flat Earth Fall: Luna will probabilistically fall, and then make everyone who sees her fall probabilistically fall as well, regardless of friend or foe
[/olist]
    Luna's scythe has a special battle technique: when the technique is activated, Luna will sprint in the direction of the attack while wielding her scythe, dealing damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/c14fa9caa21092dae3b3473309dbc2cfc234da1d.gif[/img]
[b]Starr Sapphire:[/b]
    Starr is a long-range mage who fires star bullets that can split, and she has the following skills:
[olist]
[*]         Meteor Shower: Summons a large number of star bullets in the attack position for a frame drop attack. This skill basically can't hit anyone
[*]         Comet Jump: when Starr realizes he's going to be hit, he'll probability teleport, instantly moving to a nearby location
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/1b8cd620fb6a8985c825c006cb833419ced4f13e.gif[/img]
The Three Fairies of Light will call out to each other in battle, and the player will face the attacks of all three at the same time!

Also updated the Fairy Queen's location, moving it from the Fairy Queen's Visitation Hall to the second floor of the Enchanted Forest.

notes.title: Fixed the problem that the screen could not be zoomed correctly
notes.content:
Fixed the problem that the screen could not be zoomed correctly, now you should be able to zoom the screen correctly by pressing F3 in the game.
In addition, increased the player's ability to dodge, and added the display of the boss's blood bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/9c31ae470491ea3edd21e958a511e391355f4ba5.png[/img]

notes.title: The direction of the game's updates
notes.content:
The direction of updates:
[list]
[*] Currently I'm trying to fix the game's drop mechanism and the game's economic system so that players' equipment and skills can be updated properly.
[*] In addition to fixing bugs and values, the latest update will mainly add some new characters and new items.
[*] After that, we will update the scenes of the underground world (map + characters + items + possible quests), as well as possible scenes of the Tower of White Jade, Divine Spirit Mausoleum, and part of the Makai.
[*] In the future, mods will be supported, players can use scripts to build triggers to realize certain custom effects, such as making their own items with special effects, item triggers will trigger explosions when they detect enemies approaching, and so on.
[/list]

When playing the game, you can click Koishi in the title screen to enter the quick battle menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/d1080716c8358703a489d45d299f42f2a689ff56.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963046/f074256a81f784c6c15f1d7ae5a79ae5523fa9bb.png[/img]
You can directly obtain specific equipment and skills here, and this may be able to compensate for some of the current problems of the game. On the right hand side, you can define up to 4 teams of opposing players, where the player team is the player's teammate. Once a team is configured, clicking on Start Battle will allow you to engage in quick battles.
Quick Battles allow you to challenge specific monsters and characterize their fighting style; you can also characterize the performance of various equipment through Quick Battles.

In addition, if you feel that you can't fight the monsters, you can press the "`" key to open the console and type "place 3000002b at me" to spawn the "Fairy Greatsword" at your feet.

I'll keep improving and I hope you have fun 😊
